translation.The primary sensor drives energy, cost,: The primary sensor drives energy, cost, daily usage and session history. Comparison sensors are displayed separately and are never silently summed into total PC draw.
translation.Estimated cost is primary sensor energy: Estimated cost is primary sensor energy in kWh multiplied by your configured rate.
translation.Set the high power threshold to 0 W to d: Set the high power threshold to 0 W to disable the highlight.
